data.title: Common pin
data.summary: Office aids · Ordinary pin whose head, tip and shaft each serve as simple bedside diagnostic tools.
data.body:
Ordinary pin whose head, tip and shaft each serve as simple bedside diagnostic tools.

## Parts
- Head
- Body (shaft)
- Tip

## Uses / indications
- Head: crude touch sensation in leprosy and neurological conditions
- Head: eliciting deep dermal tenderness
- Head: showing the feeding vessel of a spider angioma
- Head: demonstrating scales - scratch sign (pityriasis versicolor), carpet-tack / cat's-tongue sign (DLE, pemphigus foliaceus), Auspitz sign (psoriasis), wafer-like scale (pityriasis lichenoides chronica)
- Head: stroking skin for dermographism and Darier's sign
- Head: chemical cauterisation
- Tip: pain sensation in leprosy, HSAN, congenital insensitivity to pain
- Tip: extracting mites
- Shaft: lifting the buried distal end of an ingrowing hair in pseudofolliculitis

## Viva points & tips
- Use a fresh sterile pin for each patient when breaking skin
